name: Zeboim
overview: Zeboim, also called Zeboiim, is identified in Scripture as one of the cities in the Valley of Siddim, closely associated with the infamous cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, and Admah. It appears as a city whose king participated in the ancient battles recorded in Genesis 14, and it is also mentioned as part of the devastated region overthrown by the LORD's judgment, described as brimstone and burning land in Deuteronomy 29. Additionally, Zeboim is noted geographically as a valley near Benjamin, indicating its continued recognition in later biblical history.
